references.text: Describes the same boundary line from Judah's perspective, including En-Shemesh and the ascent to Adummim, mentioned in this parallel boundary description.
Mentions the Stone of Bohan, son of Reuben, as a boundary marker between Judah and Benjamin.
The preceding verse in the same boundary description, which continues to describe the border of Benjamin.
En-Shemesh is mentioned as a Levitical city in the territory of Benjamin.
